newsitem.title: FRANCE: French car sales fall 10.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: French car sales fall 10.3 pct in April.

text.p: New car sales in France fell 10.3 percent in April to 164,392 units, according to provisional figures released on Friday by the French carmakers association CCFA.
On a comparable day basis -- there were 22 working days last month, compared with 21 for April 1996 -- sales were down 14.4 percent, the CCFA said in a statement.
PSA Peugeot Citroen new car sales in France fell 18.6 percent to 46,896, while Renault SA sales declined 2.3 percent to 42,569.
For the first four months of 1997, car sales were down 22.5 percent to 571,228 from 737,105 for the same period in 1996.
French carmakers took 54.4 percent of the market in April.
Provisional French car sales figures for April 1997 -
Totals may not add up because PSA or Renault figures do not include vehicles sold by niche producers or because of rounding.
